name: web3-data
description: > Two services in one skill: (1) Web3 on-chain data via Chainbase CLI — use when the user asks about blockchain data, token holders, wallet addresses, token prices, ENS domains, transactions, DeFi portfolios, or any on-chain analytics. Triggers: "top holders of", "who holds", "wallet address", "token price", "token transfers", "ENS domain", "on-chain data", "blockchain query", "SQL query on-chain", across Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, zkSync, and other EVM chains.
author: internet-court
summary_zh: 一个通过命令行查询多条 EVM 链上数据的工具，适合分析代币持仓、钱包交易、价格、ENS 和 DeFi 资产。
